zh-CN.title: 聊天背景明暗自适应
items: 浅色背景使用暖白界面，深色背景使用深蓝界面
顶部栏、锁定区和昵称标签会统一适配背景明暗

en.title: Adaptive light and dark chat backgrounds
items: Light backgrounds now use warm light chrome while dark backgrounds use deep blue chrome
Headers, pinned messages, and name labels adapt together to the wallpaper tone
